name: 6. Password Cracking
description: Understand how passwords are cracked and how to defend them: authentication mechanisms, attack categories, cracking techniques, tooling, and countermeasures, all from an authorized, defensive viewpoint.

stages.stageText: A regional credit union signed off on an authorized password resilience review. Stay inside the signed scope and frame every finding for defenders.

answers: A way to make a system's encryption mathematically unbreakable so that stored passwords can never be read.

stages.stageText: The client needs a next step. Which response best protects credentials and reduces risk?

skills.name: Password Cracking Fundamentals
skills.description: Explain what password cracking is and why it usually starts an intrusion, from an authorized viewpoint.

skills.name: Password Complexity Review
skills.description: Assess password choices and recommend length and complexity policy that resists common attacks.

skills.name: SAM Storage Awareness
skills.description: Understand how the SAM database stores hashes and which controls protect it from dumping.

skills.name: NTLM Risk Review
skills.description: Identify weak NTLM and LM authentication exposure and recommend stronger schemes.

skills.name: Kerberos Trust Review
skills.description: Explain Kerberos ticketing and the monitoring needed to keep the trust model safe.

skills.name: Non-Technical Attack Awareness
skills.description: Recognize non-electronic credential attacks and the human-focused controls that counter them.

skills.name: Active Online Attack Recognition
skills.description: Identify active online credential attacks and the live-service controls that blunt them.

skills.name: Passive Online Attack Recognition
skills.description: Recognize passive online attacks and the transport encryption that defeats them.

skills.name: Offline Attack Analysis
skills.description: Explain offline hash cracking and the storage controls that make dumps hard to reverse.

skills.name: Dictionary Attack Defense
skills.description: Counter dictionary attacks with common and breached password screening.

skills.name: Brute-Force Resistance
skills.description: Raise the cost of brute-force attacks with length, lockouts, and slow hashing.

skills.name: Rule-Based Attack Awareness
skills.description: Understand how known password formats enable targeted attacks and avoid predictable policy.

skills.name: Hybrid Attack Defense
skills.description: Stop hybrid attacks by preventing incremental reuse of old passwords.

skills.name: Syllable Attack Awareness
skills.description: Recognize that invented short passwords still fall to syllable attacks, and prefer length.

skills.name: Guessing Resistance
skills.description: Reduce guessing success by removing personal-info passwords and adding lockouts.

skills.name: Default Credential Hygiene
skills.description: Eliminate shipped default credentials during provisioning across all devices.

skills.name: Endpoint Credential Theft Defense
skills.description: Defend endpoints against keyloggers and spyware that harvest credentials.

skills.name: Pass-the-Hash Containment
skills.description: Limit pass-the-hash impact by ending credential reuse and isolating admin tiers.

skills.name: Name Resolution Poisoning Defense
skills.description: Close LLMNR and NBT-NS poisoning paths with disabling and SMB signing.

skills.name: Kerberos Ticket Abuse Defense
skills.description: Reduce pass-the-ticket risk through KRBTGT protection and ticket monitoring.

skills.name: Wire Sniffing Defense
skills.description: Protect credentials in transit by removing cleartext protocols and encrypting traffic.

skills.name: MITM and Replay Defense
skills.description: Counter interception and replay with validated TLS and anti-replay protections.

skills.name: Rainbow Table Defense
skills.description: Defeat precomputed table attacks with per-user salts and slow hashing.

skills.name: Audit Tool Literacy: L0phtCrack
skills.description: Use a password auditing tool responsibly to surface weak accounts during sanctioned reviews.

skills.name: Rainbow Tool Literacy: ophcrack
skills.description: Demonstrate unsalted-hash weakness with a rainbow tool inside an approved audit.

skills.name: Time-Memory Tradeoff Literacy
skills.description: Explain the time-memory tradeoff behind table attacks and the defenses that neutralize it.

skills.name: Offline Cracker Literacy
skills.description: Map offline and online cracking tools to safe handling and remediation actions.

skills.name: Password Defense Hardening
skills.description: Combine storage, authentication, and monitoring controls into a layered password defense.
